Build the complete CAMERA feature table with reference-relative status

Source: R/CAMERA_evaluation_functions.R
build_full_feature_table.Rd

Extends build_compound_instance_table to cover every CAMERA feature in CAMERA_annotated_pool_FT, not only reference-bearing ones. Reference-bearing rows are produced exactly as build_compound_instance_table would; every CAMERA feature with no reference entry at all is added as an additional row. Every row — both kinds — carries a single ref_status column using the our definitions , computed identically to (and consistent with) classify_ref_status:

Ref-confirmed

Co-grouped with the compound's anchor.

Ref-conflicting

Reference entry exists, split from anchor.

Ref-unmatched, co-grouped

No reference entry, but sits in a pcgroup that contains some OTHER compound's anchor — diagnostic of over-grouping.

Ref-unmatched, unrelated

No reference entry, and its pcgroup contains no anchor at all — a reference-set coverage gap, not a CAMERA grouping outcome.

Ref-unassigned

Reference entry exists, but the tool assigned the feature no group (zero for CAMERA).

Every row has mz and rt: reference rows from MS1Match, the other rows from the CAMERA peak list (mz, rt).

For Ref-unmatched rows, compound_instance, MS1Match_lib_group, MS1Match_reference_tier, MS1Match_anno, and MS1Match_iso are NA (no compound owns the row). CAMERA_Anchor_pcgroup_Refconfirmed_pct and CAMERA_anno_correct are also left NA for these rows by design: the former is a specific compound's own share of its anchor pcgroup, the latter requires an MS1Match-expected mass to check CAMERA's call against — neither exists when no compound owns the row.

Usage

build_full_feature_table(
  eval_full,
  anchors,
  purity,
  CAMERA_annotated_pool_FT,
  anno_accuracy
)

Arguments

eval_full

data.frame. Output of build_eval_full.

anchors

data.frame. Output of build_anchors.

purity

list. Output of build_pcgroup_purity.

CAMERA_annotated_pool_FT

data.frame. The FULL CAMERA-annotated feature table (every feature, not pre-filtered to reference matches).

anno_accuracy

list. Output of build_anno_accuracy. Passed through to build_compound_instance_table to populate CAMERA_anno_correct.

Value

A data.frame: all build_compound_instance_table columns (including CAMERA_isotopes, CAMERA_adduct as separate columns and CAMERA_anno_correct), plus ref_status (ordered factor, 5 levels), covering every feature in CAMERA_annotated_pool_FT.

See also

build_compound_instance_table, classify_ref_status, build_benchmark_table_from_full
